If defying the norms as per the Contract a legal action may be taken against me as per the existing Rules. 4. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses (a) The bidder has to upload the certificate of acceptance of all the terms and conditions of the bid alongwi th the bid reference number. (b) The vendor will give the product details/brochure for which bid/prices are offered. In the absence of offered product details/ brochure, the bid is bound to be rejected. (c) Items will be delivered as per the specifications mentioned by the user. (d) Bids submitted by different firms from the same IP address will be rejected. (e) Missing details, if any, will assumed as per good Engineering practice and will be provided by the vend or after being approved by Commanding Officer 115 Engineer Regiment. (f) Samples will be produced by the L1 vendor for approval and bulk delivery will be made only after sampl e approval within the stipulated delivery period. No additional time will be granted for sample approval. (g) In case of any ambiguity in any given technical specification Vendor must clarify the same from CO 115 Engineer Regiment or detailed Engineer rep before participation in bid through representation on GeM. (h) Warranty. All products should have minimum 1 year of manufacturing defect. . 6. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods
